primary.title: Bank holidays in August: SBI, HDFC, other lenders to be closed for 14 days next month; Check full RBI calendar here
primary.summary: In August 2026, RBI has marked 14 holidays for banks, during which in-branch services will not be available. UPI, ATM and other such essential services remain functional on holidays. Check full RBI's bank holiday calendar for next month here.
